He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Pepperdine Waves men's basketball|Pepperdine Waves]]. ==High school career== Edwards played basketball for [[Etiwanda High School]] in [[Rancho Cucamonga, California]]. As a junior, he averaged 17 points and nine rebounds per game, earning First Team All-[[Baseline League]] honors.{{cite web |last=Marshall |first=Pete |title=All-area boys basketball: Chino Hills' LiAngelo Ball is Player of the year |url=https://www.sbsun.com/2017/04/12/all-area-boys-basketball-chino-hills-liangelo-ball-is-player-of-the-year/ |website=[[The San Bernardino Sun]] |access-date=April 1, 2021 |date=April 12, 2017}} Edwards averaged 21.3 points and 7.3 rebounds per game as a senior and was named Baseline League MVP.{{cite web |last=Gardner |first=Michelle |title=Onyeka Okongwu named 2018 Bulletin/Sun All-Area Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://www.dailybulletin.com/2018/04/12/onyeka-okongwu-named-2018-bulletin-sun-all-area-basketball-player-of-the-year/ |website=[[Inland Valley Daily Bulletin]] |access-date=April 1, 2021 |date=April 12, 2018}} He competed for Prodigy Elite on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] circuit.{{cite web |last=Ugland |first=Devin |title=Recruiting Report: Kessler Edwards (2018) |url=https://www.prephoops.com/2017/07/recruiting-report-kessler-edwards-2018/ |website=Prep Hoops |access-date=April 27, 2021 |date=July 20, 2017}} A consensus three-star recruit, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Pepperdine Waves men's basketball|Pepperdine]].{{cite web |last=Resendiz |first=Jacob |title=Dream Realized: Edwards Brothers Play Together on Pepperdine's Mens Basketball Team |url=https://pepperdine-graphic.com/dream-realized-edwards-brothers-play-together-on-pepperdines-mens-basketball-team/ |website=The Graphic |access-date=April 1, 2021 |date=August 26, 2018}} ==College career== As a freshman at Pepperdine, Edwards averaged 10 points and 5.6 rebounds per game. He was a WCC All-Freshman Team selection.{{cite web |title=Pepperdine's Edwards Invited to USA Basketball U19 Camp |url=https://wccsports.com/news/2019/5/29/mens-basketball-pepperdines-edwards-invited-to-usa-basketball-u19-camp.aspx |publisher=[[West Coast Conference]] |access-date=April 27, 2021 |date=May 23, 2019}} As a sophomore, Edwards averaged 13.8 points and a team-leading 7.5 rebounds per game. He was named to the Second Team All-WCC.{{cite web |last=Burgess |first=Jason |title=WCC Basketball: Breakout candidates from each team for 2020–21 season |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2020/06/19/wcc-basketball-breakout-candidates-team-2020-21-season/6/ |website=Busting Brackets |publisher=[[FanSided]] |access-date=September 21, 2020 |date=June 19, 2020}} On January 21, 2021, he recorded a career-high 37 points and 11 rebounds in an 85–68 win over [[Pacific Tigers men's basketball|Pacific]].{{cite web |title=Former Etiwanda star Kessler Edwards is having fine season for Pepperdine; will he be in NBA some day? |url=https://www.fontanaheraldnews.com/sports/former-etiwanda-star-kessler-edwards-is-having-fine-season-for-pepperdine-will-he-be-in/article_fdaaa6aa-6afe-11eb-a8de-a7cfcb7eb589.html |website=[[Fontana Herald News]] |access-date=April 1, 2021 |date=February 9, 2021}} He led Pepperdine to the [[2021 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] title and was named MVP.{{cite web |last=Jackson |first=McKenzie |title=Pepperdine Men's Basketball Wins CBI Title |url=http://www.malibutimes.com/malibu_life/article_0c3d622c-91e5-11eb-88d3-9bc98a38845e.html |website=[[The Malibu Times]] |access-date=April 1, 2021 |date=March 30, 2021 |archive-date=March 31, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210331180708/http://www.malibutimes.com/malibu_life/article_0c3d622c-91e5-11eb-88d3-9bc98a38845e.html |url-status=dead }} As a junior, Edwards averaged 17.2 points and 6.8 rebounds per game, earning First Team All-WCC recognition. On April 23, 2021, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=April 23, 2021 |title=Pepperdine's Kessler Edwards declaring for 2021 NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/31315929 |access-date=April 27, 2021 |website=[[ESPN]]}} He later signed with BDA and WME Sports, forgoing his remaining eligibility.{{cite web |last=Vault |first=Jacoby Jr. |date=June 30, 2021 |title=BDA and WME Signs Kessler Edwards |url=https://sportsagentblog.com/2021/06/30/bda-and-wme-signs-kessler-edwards/ |access-date=July 15, 2021 |website=Sports Agent Blog}} ==Professional career== ===Brooklyn Nets (2021–2023)=== Edwards was selected in the second round of the [[2021 NBA draft]] with the 44th pick by the [[Brooklyn Nets]],{{cite news|title=Ex-Etiwanda High School star Kessler Edwards is chosen by Brooklyn Nets in NBA draft|url=https://www.fontanaheraldnews.com/sports/ex-etiwanda-high-school-star-kessler-edwards-is-chosen-by-brooklyn-nets-in-nba-draft/article_d47c11e0-f188-11eb-867e-176c733b4812.html|work=Fontana Herald News|date=July 30, 2021|access-date=August 2, 2021}} and was later included in the roster of the Nets for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets announce summer League roster|url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/2021/08/03/brooklyn-nets-announce-summer-league-roster|website=NBA.com|date=August 3, 2021|access-date=August 6, 2021}} On August 16, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Nets. Under the terms of the deal, he split time between Brooklyn and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Long Island Nets]].{{cite web |last=Sapp |first=Demetris |date=August 16, 2021 |title=BROOKLYN NETS SIGN KESSLER EDWARDS TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT |url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/2021/08/16/brooklyn-nets-sign-kessler-edwards-two-way-contract |access-date=September 12, 2021 |website=NBA.com}} On April 10, 2022, Edwards' deal was promoted to a standard contract. While with the nets he saw much playing name with all have 21 minutes a game over 42 games{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets Sign Kessler Edwards|url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/2022/04/10/brooklyn-nets-sign-kessler-edwards|website=NBA.com|date=April 10, 2022|access-date=April 10, 2022}} In those games, Edwards averaged 5.9 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 0.6 assists.{{Cite web|title=Kessler Edwards 2021-22 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397693/type/nba/year/2022|access-date=August 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On July 6, 2022, Edwards re-signed with the Nets to a reported two-year contract.{{cite web |title=Brooklyn Nets Re-sign Kessler Edwards |url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/2022/07/06/brooklyn-nets-re-sign-kessler-edwards |website=NBA.com |access-date=July 12, 2022 |date=July 6, 2022}}{{cite web |last=Milholen |first=Chris |title=Nets re-sign Kessler Edwards to reported two-year deal with team option |url=https://www.netsdaily.com/2022/7/6/23196910/nets-re-sign-kessler-edwards-reported-two-year-deal-with-team-option |website=NetsDaily |access-date=July 12, 2022 |date=July 6, 2022}} He made 14 appearances (including one start) for Brooklyn during his sophomore campaign, recording averages of 1.1 points, 1.0 rebound, and 0.1 assists. ===Sacramento Kings (2023–2024)=== On February 8, 2023, Edwards and cash considerations were traded to the [[Sacramento Kings]] in exchange for the draft rights to [[David Michineau]].{{cite web|title=Kings Complete Trade With Brooklyn Nets|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-complete-trade-with-brooklyn-nets|website=NBA.com|date=February 8, 2023|access-date=February 8, 2023}} He made 22 appearances (including three starts) over the remainder of the year, averaging 3.9 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 1.0 assists.{{Cite web|title=Kessler Edwards 2022-23 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397693/type/nba/year/2023|access-date=August 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} Edwards made 54 appearances for Sacramento during the [[2023–24 NBA season]], recording averages of 1.7 points, 0.8 rebounds, and 0.3 assists.{{Cite web|title=Kessler Edwards 2023-24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397693/type/nba/year/2024|access-date=August 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ===Dallas Mavericks (2024–2025)=== On August 27, 2024, Edwards signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{cite web|title=Mavericks Sign Kessler Edwards to Two-Way . With the Dallas Mavericks He had his best game of his NBA career with 22 points and 12 rebounds. Contract|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/mavericks-sign-kessler-edwards-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=August 27, 2024|access-date=August 27, 2024}} Edwards made 40 appearances (including 18 starts) for Dallas during the [[2024–25 NBA season|2024–25 season]], averaging 4.2 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 1.1 assists.{{Cite web|title=Kessler Edwards 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397693/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=August 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ===Grand Rapids Gold (2025–2026)=== On August 12, 2025, Edwards signed a one-year contract with the [[Denver Nuggets]].{{Cite web |last=Veazey |first=Austin |date=2025-08-12 |title=Former versatile Mavericks forward joining Nikola Jokic, Denver Nuggets |url=https://www.si.com/nba/mavericks/news/former-versatile-dallas-mavericks-forward-joining-nikola-jokic-denver-nuggets-kessler-edwards |access-date=2025-09-08 |website=Dallas Mavericks On SI |language=}} He was waived by the Nuggets prior to the start of the regular season on October 18.{{Cite web |date=2025-10-18 |title=Kessler Edwards: Waived by Denver |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/kessler-edwards-waived-by-denver/ |access-date=2025-10-18 |website=CBS Sports |language=en}}{{cite web | last=Koch | first=Jared | title=Nuggets Waive Two Players Ahead of Regular Season | website=Denver Nuggets On SI | date=2025-10-18 | url=https://www.si.com/nba/nuggets/onsi/news/denver-nuggets-waive-two-players-kessler-edwards-moses-brown | access-date=2025-12-06}} He was then assigned to the Nuggets' G League affiliate, the [[Grand Rapids Gold]]. ===Hapoel Tel Aviv (2026)=== On February 19, 2026, Edwards signed with [[Hapoel Tel Aviv B.C.|Hapoel Tel Aviv]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League|Israeli Premier League]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{cite web |title=Hapoel finds frontcourt firepower with Kessler Edwards at forward |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/hapoel-finds-frontcourt-firepower-with-kessler-edwards-at-forward/ |website=[[EuroLeague Basketball]] |date=February 19, 2026 |access-date=February 19, 2026 }} In 13 appearances for Tel Aviv, he recorded averages of 3.8 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 0.5 assists. On June 7, Edwards parted ways with the club.{{Cite web|title=International Notes: K. Edwards, NBA Europe, Zizic|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2026/06/international-notes-k-edwards-c-edwards-nba-europe-zizic.html|access-date=July 6, 2026|website=hoopsrumors.com|language=en}}
